Established Hindi loan nouns bus, cycle, jag, tikat and pensil are proposed common borrowings. Names are shared entities. R must otherwise use Hindi phrasing in Roman script; substantive English clauses/relations are disallowed. C requires a productive English predicate, clause or mathematical relation alongside Hindi; object nouns alone do not qualify. Reviewers must flag disputed borrowings before the policy is frozen.
